newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BBL says no merger talks going on.
newsitem.headline: BBL says no merger talks going on.

text.p: Banque Bruxelles Lambert (BBL) said on Wednesday it was not taking part in any bank merger talks.

"There are no talks going on whatsoever at the moment. An industrial project could be a good thing, but there is no such project today," BBL chairman Jacques Moulaert told shareholders at their annual meeting in response to a question about rumours BBL would merge with Generale Bank.

A possible merger between BBL and Generale Bank has been talked about for more than a year, and the management and some shareholders of the groups have indicated they would favour such a project, but so far it has been blocked by opposition from Internationale Nederlanden Groep (ING).
ING is a leading BBL minority shareholder which has 30.40 percent of BBL stock and controls the voting rights on another 6.73 percent until the end of February next year.
